name: get_package
description: Look up a single Hex.pm package (Elixir/Erlang mix package) by name. Returns description, licenses, links, latest version, and download counts.

name: search_packages
description: Search the Hex.pm registry for Elixir/Erlang mix packages by keyword. Returns a list of matching packages with descriptions, latest versions, and downloads.

name: get_release
description: Get details for a specific version (release) of a Hex.pm package (Elixir/Erlang mix package): dependency requirements, docs availability, publisher, and downloads.

name: list_releases
description: List all published versions (releases) of a Hex.pm package (Elixir/Erlang mix package), each with its version and publish date.
